'''Brinebrew''' was a [[Salt/Legends|salty]] beverage. At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Iyra]] [[sentientologist]] [[Tem Eliss]] drank brinebrew from a mug in his office at the [[University of Sanbra]],<ref name="AEG" /> a [[University/Legends|school]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sanbra]],<ref name="CSWE III 125">{{CSWECite|III|125|Sanbra}}.</ref> as he worked on a [[Book/Legends|manuscript]] called ''[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life]]'' and sat in his [[aquachair]].<ref name="AEG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The short story "[[An Extinct Guest]]," written by [[Trevor J. Wilson]] and [[Craig Robert Carey]], features brinebrew. The story was published in [[August]] [[1997]] as part of the article "[[Alien Encounters (article series)|Alien Encounters]]" in [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 14|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 14]].<ref name="AEG" />
